answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust matrix, while exponential temporal decay halves reputation after a fixed interval, making influence require sustained honest service rather than a burst of favorable reports. EigenTrust factorization propagates support, but a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality and negligible transitive weight; even a plume of colluding raven identities cannot raise its kernel score enough to pass consensus.
